title: A one-element array round-trips to a string even with limits wide open
rationale: Isolates the size>1 detection gate from maxArraySize entirely. The previous fixture confounds truncation with detection; this removes truncation and leaves only the gate, proving the lower arity bound is broken independently of any configured limit.
catchesBugClass: Arity-boundary handling in array inference, independent of configured limits. A direct regression guard on the size>1 gate: the moment it is replaced with a structural signal, this fixture flips to LOSSLESS.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the empty-array boundary, which fails earlier and differently. It also cannot catch top-level arrays, which are not detected at any arity.

predicted.detail: Flattening is exactly right; reconstruction fails on arity alone. At arity 1 the array degrades to a string while at arity 2 the PARENT is wrongly promoted, so no single-sided fix resolves both.
